correctness.rationale: The global two-input upper bounds follow from exact directional derivatives in constant-step directions, three-window support, triangle inequality in the input-edge basis, and integration of continuous piecewise-affine chambers. Four exact strict rank witnesses attain the branch values and extend to all larger n. The separate one-input bound follows from a threshold layer-cake identity, a complete 16-state/32-edge binary Bellman potential whose inequalities are independently verified by check.py, and coarea. For n=5, a one-coordinate replacement has slope magnitude at most one. Explicit binary one-input witnesses attain bounds. The packaged checker verifies exact rational calculations; no finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A middle-two rank gap is a natural four-site robust local contrast estimator, not an arbitrary rank substitution. Its own-signal variation and perturbation sensitivity are structurally inequivalent. Exact saturation at dimensions six and eight, respectively, and the sharp contrast between factors two and six give nontrivial filter stability design data. The small 16-state certificate supplies a motivated structural proof of the universal one-input bound, while the 2-input sharpness is witnessed by finite signals.
